battle.name: 孫策平江東之戰
battle.theater: 江東吳郡、會稽、丹楊、廬江
battle.brief: 興平初年（194），孫策以孫堅舊部東渡長江，數年間破劉勳、劉繇、嚴白虎、王朗，斬張英、周昕，終於沙羨大破黃祖，盡有江東諸郡。卡面羅馬弩砲屬地中海世界的攻城利器，與此役並無交集；江東戰場上真正見於記載的投射手段，是漢軍的蹶張弩、大黃弩，以及攻城所用的雲梯、衝車與飛石。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭是建安年間孫氏集團在江東地區進行的內戰兼統一戰，交戰各方都不是中央朝廷的正規部隊。孫策一方最初掛袁術的名號：興平元年以行殄寇將軍、折衝校尉率孫堅舊部渡江，兵源為吳郡、丹楊、廬江的宗族部曲與北來散卒，基幹是程普、黃蓋、韓當、朱治等老將，以及呂範、張昭、張紘、周瑜、太史慈等謀士與歸附將領；建安二年與袁術恩斷義絕後改向曹操，曹操表奏其為征西將軍、封吳公，江東政權的名分由此轉為朝廷認可。劉繇一方是朝廷任命的揚州刺史，以丹楊太守曲阿為基地，令樊能守橫江津口、張英守當利口，藉長江天險與北岸相持；會稽太守王朗自成一系，屯兵固陵與高遷，功曹虞翻勸其避鋒而不聽；吳郡還有嚴白虎、陳瑀等聚眾自守的武裝與許昭、許貢的勢力。廬江劉勳於199年以皖城為基地收容袁術餘眾，成為孫策西進的阻力。荊州方向，劉表部將黃祖守江夏，既是殺孫堅的舊仇，也是江東的西面屏障。其餘非正規參戰方還有山越各部、祖郎，以及劉表從子劉磐與黃忠等地方武裝。整體而言，這是一場以宗族、部曲、郡兵混合編成的並非國家對國家的地方爭霸，孫策靠整合散兵與流亡士人取勝，最終壟斷吳、丹楊、會稽、廬江四郡。
countriesEn: This war was a civil and unification conflict fought in the Jiangdong region in the Jian'an era, in which none of the belligerents were regular forces of the imperial court. Sun Ce's side initially operated under Yuan Shu's authority: in the first year of Xingping (194) he crossed the Yangtze with the title of Xing Qiankou Jiangjun and a Zhexiong Xiaowei, drawing his soldiers from the clan levies of Wu Commandery, Danyang and Lujiang together with northern refugees, on a backbone of veteran officers such as Cheng Pu, Huang Gai, Han Dang and Zhu Zhi, and of strategists and defectors such as Lü Fan, Zhang Zhao, Zhang Hong, Zhou Yu and Taishi Ci. In the second year of Jian'an, after he broke with Yuan Shu, he turned to Cao Cao, who memorialized the court to make him a Zhengxi Jiangjun and enfeoff him as Duke of Wu; from then on the legitimacy of the Jiangdong regime rested on court recognition. Liu Yao's side was the officially appointed Inspector of Yangzhou, based at Qu'a as Administrator of Danyang, with Fan Neng holding the Hengjiang ferry and Zhang Ying the Dangkou, relying on the Yangtze to hold off the north. Wang Lang, Administrator of Kuaiji, formed a separate camp, stationing troops at Guling and Gaoqian, and his adviser Yu Fan urged him to avoid the enemy's edge, which he ignored. In Wu Commandery the armed bands of Yan Baihu and Chen Yu held out, and there were also the local powers of Xu Zhao and Xu Gong. In Lujiang, Liu Xun made his base at Wancheng in 199, sheltering Yuan Shu's surviving followers and blocking Sun Ce's western advance. In the Jingzhou direction, Huang Zu under Liu Biao defended Jiangxia: he was the killer of Sun Jian and the western shield of Jiangdong. Other irregular participants included the mountain peoples, the bandit Zulang, and Liu Biao's nephew Liu Pan with Huang Zhong. Overall this was a local contest for power fought with mixed clan levies, local militia and commandery troops rather than national armies, and Sun Ce won it by absorbing scattered soldiers and wandering talent, finally controlling the four commanderies of Wu, Danyang, Kuaiji and Lujiang.
people: 孫策是全役核心。吳郡富春人，父孫堅為漢廷破虜將軍，征討董卓時名動一時，後在攻打劉勳部將黃祖的戰鬥中被射殺，孫策以少年喪父之身寄於袁術帳下，靠散兵舊將迅速聚起數千眾。謀主呂範出自汝南，把門下食客盡數交付孫策，是最早看穿其雄心並替他周旋於袁術幕府的人；朱治、張紘先後勸他渡江自立、又勸他與袁術決裂。弟孫權少時即隨軍議事，陽羨長、茂才、孝廉皆出其選，孫策每宴賓客必指孫權說「這些人日後都是你的臣將」。周瑜自舒赴援，率兵五百並帶船筏、糧秣、兵械星夜趕到，孫策見之曰「我得卿，事可成」；後與策合兵破皖城、鎮巴丘、入會稽。張昭、張紘、虞翻、孫靜分掌文書、謀議、內應與側翼：孫靜獻聲東擊西之策，遣軍夜渡查瀆直趨高遷，斬周昕而一舉平會稽；虞翻則先勸王朗避鋒，事後又追隨其出逃至東冶。吳景、孫賁、孫輔、孫香等宗族將領先後脫袁術歸吳；程普、黃蓋、韓當、蔣欽、周泰、陳武、董襲、凌操、呂蒙先後來投，其中陳武以廬江上甲為精銳。敵方關鍵人物有揚州刺史劉繇、其部將張英與樊能，會稽太守王朗，吳郡嚴白虎及其弟嚴輿，自稱太守的陳瑀，廬江劉勳與謀主劉曄，江夏黃祖與荊州援軍將領劉虎、韓唏。199年劉勳西出海昏之前，劉曄曾力勸「兵馬疲憊在外，國內空虛」而劉勳不聽，此舉是其敗亡的關鍵。195年劉繇部下的東萊人太史慈夜襲孫策營寨，單騎闖入直取孫策，事敗被擒，孫策親解其縛、與之結為知己，授建昌都尉；後奉命赴豫章招撫劉繇散卒，臨行稱六十日必還，眾將皆疑其不返，孫策力言「我識人眼光不會錯」。200年正月沙羨之戰，孫策手擊急鼓、齊步勢、弓弩齊發，斬韓唏、潰黃祖軍、繳戰船六千艘，溺死者達萬人。同年五月，孫策出獵，許貢門客乘隙以矢射之，傷重卒於丹徒，年二十六，弟孫權嗣位。
peopleEn: Sun Ce is the central figure of the whole campaign. A native of Fuchun in Wu Commandery, his father Sun Jian had been the Han court's Buluo Jiangjun and had become famous during the campaign against Dong Zhuo, only to be killed by an arrow while attacking Huang Zu, one of Liu Xun's officers; Sun Ce, left fatherless while still young, took refuge under Yuan Shu and quickly gathered several thousand men from scattered soldiers and old officers. His strategist Lü Fan, a native of Runan, handed over all of his own retainers to Sun Ce and was the first to read his ambition, smoothing the way for him at Yuan Shu's court; Zhu Zhi and Zhang Hong in turn urged him to cross the river and stand on his own, and later to break with Yuan Shu. His younger brother Sun Quan, then a boy of a dozen years, already sat in on military discussions from the Xingping years onward; he was later chosen as Xiaolian of Yangxian, and Sun Ce would say to his guests that these men would one day all be Sun Quan's ministers. Zhou Yu came over from Shu with five hundred men, bringing pontoons, grain and weapons by night, and Sun Ce greeted him with the words: now that I have you, the business is certain to succeed; he later joined Sun Ce in storming Wancheng, was left to guard Baqiu, and took part in the reduction of Kuaiji. Zhang Zhao, Zhang Hong, Yu Fan and Sun Jing respectively handled documents, strategy, internal contacts and the flanking movement: Sun Jing proposed the feint that took the army by night across Chadu to strike Gaoqian and kill Zhou Xin, which settled Kuaiji in one blow; Yu Fan had earlier counseled Wang Lang to avoid the enemy's edge, and afterwards followed him in his flight to Dongye. The clan's commanders Wu Jing, Sun Ben, Sun Fu and Sun Xiang broke with Yuan Shu one after another and joined Sun Ce; Cheng Pu, Huang Gai, Han Dang, Jiang Qin, Zhou Tai, Chen Wu, Dong Xi, Ling Cao and Lü Meng also came in, among them Chen Wu commanding the elite 'upper armour' of Lujiang. Key figures on the other side were Inspector of Yangzhou Liu Yao, whose officers Zhang Ying and Fan Neng held Dangkou and Hengjiang, Administrator of Kuaiji Wang Lang, Yan Baihu of Wu Commandery and his brother Yan Yu, the self-styled administrator Chen Yu, and in Lujiang Liu Xun with his adviser Liu Ye. Before Liu Xun marched west to Haicun in 199, Liu Ye urged that the troops would be worn out in the field while the interior was empty, but Liu Xun would not listen, and that single refusal cost him the campaign. In 195 a former officer of Liu Yao's, the Donglai man Taishi Ci, raided Sun Ce's camp by night and rode straight in after the commander; captured after his failure, he was freed by Sun Ce's own hand and taken as a confidant, and made Jianchang Duwei; he was later sent to Yuzhang to win over Liu Yao's scattered troops, promising to return within sixty days, while his fellow officers doubted that he would come back at all and Sun Ce insisted that his eye for men was not to be doubted. In the first month of Jian'an five, at Shacan, Sun Ce beat the drum with his own hand to keep the pace of the charge, loosed bows and crossbows in a single volley, killed Han Xi, destroyed Huang Zu's army and took six thousand warships, with as many as ten thousand soldiers drowned. That same May, while hunting, Sun Ce was shot by retainers of Xu Gong and died of his wounds at Dantu, aged twenty-six; his brother Sun Quan succeeded him.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）在本戰役中的位置，是一件技術同源而實物缺席的兵器。扭力弩砲是公元前二至一世紀由希臘化世界的蠻族攻城技術傳入義大利的產物：兩具獨立的扭力弓臂以繩索與銅鐵製的簧片儲能，底部有腳踏絞盤，需數人合力上弦，扳機解鎖後一發一具銅首重箭，射程可達數百步，既能平射人馬，也能以高射角壓制城頭與艦船。羅馬人在第二次布匿戰爭與對希臘化諸王國的戰役中，用它拆掉城牆、驅散密集方陣。但這件兵器與江東無涉：漢與羅馬唯一一次官方接觸發生在延熹九年（166），大秦安敦王的使者從日南郡交阯登陸，攜象牙與犀角入貢，途中遇劫，到洛陽時只剩十餘人；從交阯到江東的傳遞距離與三十年的時間差，都不可能把羅馬弩砲送進建安年間的江東戰場。真正在場的是漢家的投射體系：蹶張弩（腰張弩）是東漢軍隊的標配，由兵卒自備、以腰力上弦，射速高於張力弩；大黃弩、小黃弩、烏丸弩等張力弩以銅機廓與弩機蓄力發射，漢末長沙出土的銅連弩機已是可連發的實物。冷兵器方面，環首刀、鐵矛、戟、弓、盾、札甲與皮甲構成主力；攻城則靠雲梯、衝車、巢車、飛石機（投石砲）與壕壘器械。舟師方面，孫策的兵需在長江與內河之間轉運，沿江蘆葦編成的筏、駁船、鬥艦、走舸與蒙衝是渡江和爭奪津口的實際載具，櫓、篙、鉤槍則是水上短兵。糧秣靠船運與屯田供給，弩矢與箭桿大量自備，這一制度直接限制了每次作戰的持續攻勢。
kitsEn: The Roman Scorpio on the card occupies the place of a weapon that is technologically analogous but physically absent. The torsion catapult reached Italy in the second and first centuries BC as Hellenistic barbarian siege technology: two independent torsion arms store energy in rope and bronze or iron skeins, a treadle winch at the base lets a crew cock the engine, and the trigger releases a single heavy bronze-headed bolt, with a range of several hundred paces, usable in flat trajectories against men and horses and in high arc against wall tops and ships. The Romans used it to break down walls in the Second Punic War and in their wars against the Hellenistic kingdoms. None of that reached Jiangdong: the single official contact between Han and Rome took place in the ninth year of Yanxi (166), when envoys of the Roman emperor Antoninus landed at Jiaozhi in Rinan, bearing ivory and rhinoceros horn, were robbed on the road and reached Luoyang with barely a dozen men alive; neither the distance from Jiaozhi to Jiangdong nor the thirty-year gap could have carried a Roman scorpion into a Jian'an-era battlefield. What was actually present was the Han ballistic system. The crossbow drawn by the waist, the juezhang nü, was the standard arm of the Eastern Han soldier, carried by the troops themselves and cocked by bodily strength, giving a higher rate of fire than a tension bow; the da huang, xiao huang and wuwan crossbows of the tension type stored their power in a bronze lock and trigger mechanism, and a bronze repeating crossbow mechanism excavated from a Western Han tomb at Changsha shows that multi-shot locks already existed. For close work the line troops carried ring-pommel swords, iron spears, halberds, bows, shields, lamellar and leather armour; for siege work they used scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers, stone-throwing engines and trench works. On the water the campaign needed to move men between the Yangtze and its tributaries, so pontoons woven from river reeds, lighters, warships, fast galleys and covered ram-boats served as the real craft for crossing the river and seizing the ferries, with sweeps, poles and boarding hooks for close work afloat. Supply moved by boat and by farm; since each crossbowman carried his own bolts and shafts, every operation had to be planned around the time cost of replacing arrows.
tactics: 孫策的戰法可歸納為四條。第一是不求兵多而求兵快：袁術只給他一千餘人、戰馬幾十匹，他靠沿途收攏蔣欽、周泰、陳武、呂範、凌操等人，到歷陽時已有五六千人，卻公開以集合三萬人為志，渡江後六年之間連下吳、丹楊、會稽、廬江四郡，靠的正是沿長江順流而下、逐點奪取津口的連續機動。第二是搶在對方水軍成形之前過江：劉繇以樊能守橫江、張英守當利，孫策先取兩處津口，再依姑母建議砍蘆葦編筏，藉蘆葦掩護快速渡江，不給劉繇調集戰船的時間。第三是攻城的心理戰與奇襲：與笮融對峙時他腿部中箭，隨即放出孫郎已被射死的謠言引敵出營，設伏擊破追兵千餘；攻會稽固陵時採叔父孫靜之策，以連雨濁水腹痛、備置瓦缸數百口為辭夜燃疑兵，主力卻分道走查瀆直趨高遷，一戰斬周昕而平會稽。第四是水戰與野戰的結合：200年正月沙羨之戰，他自陳奏疏寫「臣身跨馬陣，手擊急鼓，以齊戰勢……越渡重堑，迅疾若飛；火飛上風，兵激煙下，弓弩齊發，流矢雨集」，這是典型的順風火攻加弩箭覆蓋，兩翼舟隊分割敵陣，中央步兵踏鼓齊步衝擊壕溝。側翼與後方他以駐兵控制節點：周瑜鎮巴丘，太史慈屯海昏建昌，孫賁、孫輔屯彭澤截擊劉勳，形成前鋒、側翼、後勤三段結構。糧道靠水運與屯田維持，弓弩手自備的制度意味著每次作戰都必須考慮補充箭矢的時間成本。
tacticsEn: Sun Ce's method can be reduced to four points. First, he did not seek many soldiers but fast ones: Yuan Shu gave him barely a thousand men and a few dozen horses, and he grew his force by picking up Jiang Qin, Zhou Tai, Chen Wu, Lü Fan, Ling Cao and others on the road, reaching five or six thousand by Liyang while publicly aiming at a levy of thirty thousand; after crossing the river he took the four commanderies of Wu, Danyang, Kuaiji and Lujiang in six years, and the reason was continuous movement down the Yangtze, seizing ferry after ferry. Second, he crossed before the enemy could build a fleet: Liu Yao held Hengjiang with Fan Neng and Dangkou with Zhang Ying, and Sun Ce took both crossings first, then, on his aunt's advice, cut reeds and wove them into pontoons so that the crossing could be made fast under cover, denying Liu Yao time to gather ships. Third, psychological warfare and surprise in siege: when he was wounded in the leg before Zhu Rong's camp, he spread the rumour that the Sun lang had been killed by an arrow, drew the enemy out, and ambushed a thousand men; when attacking Wang Lang at Guling he adopted his uncle Sun Jing's plan, using a story about turbid rainwater causing bellyache and hundreds of water jars being prepared to make night fires as a feint while the main body went by Chadu to strike Gaoqian, killing Zhou Xin and settling Kuaiji in one blow. Fourth, the coupling of river and land battle: at Shacan in the first month of Jian'an five he wrote in his own memorial that he crossed the battle line and beat the drum with his own hand to set the pace of the charge, that the soldiers bounded over their trenches as fast as flight, that fire flew with the wind and smoke drove the troops on, and that bows and crossbows loosed together with arrows falling like rain, a textbook high-wind fire attack covered by a volley of bolts, the flanking squadrons of boats splitting the enemy line while the infantry in the centre stepped to the drum and charged the ditch. He fixed the flanks and the rear with garrisons: Zhou Yu at Baqiu, Taishi Ci in Jianchang on Haicun, Sun Ben and Sun Fu at Pengze to intercept Liu Xun, giving the army a structure of vanguard, flank and rear echelon. Supply moved by water and by farming, and the rule that each crossbowman carried his own bolts meant every operation had to allow for the time needed to replace arrows.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但足以勾勒本役的規模。起兵時袁術奏表孫策為行殄寇將軍、折衝校尉，只配給孫堅舊部一千餘人、戰馬幾十匹，呂範把門客全部交出；孫策自述渡江之志是「可集結到三萬人」，實際到歷陽時軍眾已有五六千，渡江後因收編劉繇、嚴白虎等部眾與歸附州郡，兵數迅速上升。196年前後孫策在曲阿、丹楊一線發布文告招納劉繇、笮融的部民，記載稱不久招得士卒兩萬餘、軍馬千餘匹。199年攻廬江皖城，孫策與周瑜率兵兩萬，一舉攻下，俘虜包括劉勳妻子、袁術妻子及橋公二女在內的三萬餘人，隨後把所獲人口移往吳地，留周瑜鎮巴丘。200年正月沙羨之戰最為慘烈：荊州方面劉表遣劉虎、韓唏率長矛隊五千人增援，黃祖軍幾乎全軍覆沒，韓唏戰死，士卒溺死者達萬人，孫策繳獲戰船六千艘。另一組數字來自太史慈：奉命往豫章招撫劉繇散卒，劉繇舊部兵卒逾一萬，他約六十日而返，事後孫策表其招降之功。時間上，自興平初年（194）渡江至建安五年（200）兵敗丹徒，前後六年有餘；孫策生於熹平四年（175），遇刺時虛歲二十六。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are few, but enough to sketch the scale. At the outset Yuan Shu memorialized Sun Ce as Xing Qiankou Jiangjun and Zhexiong Xiaowei and allotted him barely a thousand of his father's old troops and a few dozen horses, with Lü Fan handing over all his own retainers; Sun Ce's stated aim was to raise thirty thousand, and in fact he had five or six thousand men by Liyang, rising quickly after the crossing as he absorbed the scattered troops of Liu Yao, Yan Baihu and the commanderies that submitted. Around 196, in the Danyang and Qu'a area, Sun Ce issued a proclamation welcoming the families and soldiers of Liu Yao and Zhu Rong, and the record says he soon drew in more than twenty thousand soldiers and over a thousand horses. In 199, assaulting Wancheng in Lujiang, Sun Ce and Zhou Yu led twenty thousand men, took the city in a single blow and captured more than thirty thousand people including Liu Xun's wife, Yuan Shu's wife and the two daughters of the Qiao clan, after which the captives were moved to the Wu area and Zhou Yu was left to hold Baqiu. The heaviest fighting came at Shacan in the first month of Jian'an five: Liu Biao sent Liu Hu and Han Xi with five thousand spearmen to reinforce Huang Zu; Huang Zu's army was almost wiped out, Han Xi was killed, as many as ten thousand soldiers drowned, and Sun Ce took six thousand warships. Another set of figures belongs to Taishi Ci: sent to Yuzhang to win over Liu Yao's scattered men, he found more than ten thousand of Liu Yao's old soldiers there and returned within sixty days as he had promised, and Sun Ce afterwards memorialized his achievement in recruiting them. In time, from the crossing in the early Xingping years (194) to his defeat at Dantu in Jian'an five (200) lies a little over six years; Sun Ce was born in the fourth year of Xiping (175) and was twenty-six by the East Asian reckoning when he was shot.
cause: 起義的直接原因有三層。第一是父仇：興平前年間，孫堅在攻打劉勳部將黃祖的戰鬥中被射死，孫策年輕喪父、聲名未立，必須自己打出一番局面才能立足。第二是地緣與宗族：孫氏三世居吳郡富春，父祖在江東素有恩義，孫策渡江不是入侵，而是回鄉取回本來就屬於自己宗族與故吏的影響力，朱治、呂範、張紘都以此勸他自立。第三是袁術的失策與亂世：興平元年淮南饑饉、袁術的根據地喪失大半，孫策以家舊日對江東人多有恩義、願帶兵幫助舅父吳景征伐橫江為辭，求兵求自由，袁術判斷江東尚有劉繇、嚴白虎、王朗數股勢力、孫策未必能成，便准他領回孫堅舊部一千餘人並奏授官職，這是官方給他的合法出師之名。國際層面上，孫策打的其實是揚州刺史劉繇與荊州牧劉表兩個朝廷命官的旗號，袁術則以仲家自立，孫策的旗號在名分上更有正統性，這也是他日後轉向曹操、接受表奏的基礎。建安二年袁術稱帝後，孫策送信勸諫不聽，遂與之恩斷義絕，並策反吳景、孫賁、孫香、周瑜等相繼來歸，統一路線由此確立。199年劉勳收容袁術餘眾、屯兵皖城，成為孫策西進的直接藉口；200年正月則是黃祖的江夏，孫策以雪父讎為名揮師西上。
causeEn: There are three layers to the cause. The first is revenge for his father: in the years before Xingping, Sun Jian was killed by an arrow while attacking Huang Zu, an officer of Liu Xun; Sun Ce was young, fatherless and without a position of his own, and had to win a campaign before he could hold any ground. The second is geography and kinship: the Sun family had lived in Fuchun in Wu Commandery for three generations, and Sun Jian's forebears had long-standing ties of favour in Jiangdong; Sun Ce's crossing was a homecoming, taking back an influence that had always belonged to his own clan and its old clients, and Zhu Zhi, Lü Fan and Zhang Hong all urged him to establish himself there on that ground. The third is Yuan Shu's miscalculation and the disorder of the age: in the first year of Xingping the Huai-Nan region was in famine and Yuan Shu's base was collapsing, so Sun Ce petitioned for men and for his own freedom on the plea that his family had long owed kindness to the people of Jiangdong and that he wished to lead troops to help his uncle Wu Jing attack Hengjiang; Yuan Shu judged that several powers still held Jiangdong, Liu Yao, Yan Baihu and Wang Lang, and that Sun Ce was not likely to succeed, so he let him take back a thousand-odd of his father's old soldiers and gave him an office, which became the legal pretext for his departure. Internationally, Sun Ce was in fact fighting in the name of two court-appointed officials, the Inspector of Yangzhou Liu Yao and the Administrator of Jingzhou Liu Biao, while Yuan Shu had set himself up as a self-styled emperor; Sun Ce's banner therefore had the better claim to legitimacy, and this was the basis on which he later turned to Cao Cao and accepted a court appointment. In the second year of Jian'an, when Yuan Shu proclaimed himself emperor, Sun Ce wrote to remonstrate, was not heard, and broke with him; Wu Jing, Sun Ben, Sun Xiang and Zhou Yu followed suit in coming over, and the unification line was fixed. In 199 Liu Xun's reception of Yuan Shu's remnants and his massing at Wancheng gave Sun Ce his immediate western pretext; in the first month of Jian'an five the target was Huang Zu's Jiangxia, and Sun Ce marched west under the banner of avenging his father.
impact: 這場戰爭決定了江東地區此後兩百年的走向。孫策在六年內把吳郡、丹楊、會稽、廬江四郡連成一片，建立孫吳政權的疆域與編制基礎：任免郡縣長吏、招攬北來士人與江東本土豪族、設置屯田與水利的雛形，使原本地廣人稀、越人散處的三吳地區開始進入有組織的開發；江南的稻作與墾殖由孫策、孫權兩代逐步推向北方，成為日後曹魏與孫吳爭奪人口與賦稅的關鍵資源。對外，這場勝利切斷了袁術的後路，加速其稱帝後的崩潰；曹操在官渡前後南顧，得以把孫策納入奉漢的名義框架，並在劉勳降曹後於江夏方向保留一個可靠的西面支點。對荊州而言，黃祖之死是劉表集團的內部裂傷，江夏北門洞開，孫策隨即得以介入江夏與江東的邊界。制度上更重要的一點是兵源轉化：孫策大量收編北來流民、丹楊與廬江的精兵以及山越武裝，孫吳軍隊由郡兵逐步轉為以募兵與屯田兵為主體的常備軍，這正是南方政權能與北方抗衡的物質基礎。孫策本人的猝死則直接改變了權力交接：十八歲的孫權在張昭、周瑜等人輔佐下續業，孫策生前培植的周瑜、張昭、太史慈、程普等人被完整保留，使江東政權沒有因統帥更替而崩潰。長期看，孫吳與曹魏的南北對峙格局在此役之後定型，三國並立的基本版圖在此時已見雛形。
impactEn: This war decided the shape of Jiangdong for the next two hundred years. In six years Sun Ce welded the four commanderies of Wu, Danyang, Kuaiji and Lujiang into one, and with them created the territory and the command structure on which the Sun-Wu state was built: appointing and removing commandery and county officers, drawing in both northern emigres and native Jiangdong clans, and setting up the first forms of military farming and water works, so that the region of Wu and Yue, sparsely peopled and scattered in the earlier centuries, began to be developed in an organized way. The cultivation of the Jiangnan paddy fields, begun under Sun Ce and continued under Sun Quan, became a strategic resource in the later struggle of Wu against Wei for population and revenue. Abroad, the victory cut off Yuan Shu's rear and hastened the collapse of his self-styled empire; Cao Cao, looking south while consolidating the north around the battle of Guandu, was able to fold Sun Ce into the framework of a regime acting for the Han, and after Liu Xun's surrender to Cao Cao the Jiangxia area remained a dependable western anchor for the northern side. For Jingzhou, the death of Huang Zu was an internal wound in Liu Biao's group and left the northern gate of Jiangxia open, which let Sun Ce move against the Jiangxia-Jiangdong border. Equally important was the change in the composition of the armies: Sun Ce absorbed large numbers of northern refugees, the picked troops of Danyang and Lujiang, and mountain groups; the Sun-Wu forces moved from commandery militia towards a standing army of recruited and garrisoned soldiers, the material basis on which a southern state could hold its own against the north. Sun Ce's sudden death also reshaped the succession: the eighteen-year-old Sun Quan took over with Zhang Zhao and Zhou Yu assisting him, and the men Sun Ce had raised, Zhou Yu, Zhang Zhao, Taishi Ci and Cheng Pu, survived intact, so the Jiangdong regime did not collapse when its commander changed. In the long run, the north-south confrontation between Sun-Wu and Cao Wei was fixed in its essential shape after this campaign, and the basic map of the Three Kingdoms was already visible.
result: 戰役以孫策一方全勝告終。劉繇放棄丹徒西奔豫章，藏身蕪湖山區，其部眾在太史慈招撫下大半歸孫策，劉繇不久病死；會稽太守王朗在固陵、高遷兩戰皆敗，逃至山陰，孫策攻破會稽後曾派張昭勸降而王朗不從，孫策自領會稽太守、待虞翻以交友之禮，王朗後來出仕孫權；吳郡嚴白虎大敗後走餘杭、下落不明，陳瑀、許昭等亦各散去。廬江方面，199年劉勳西出海昏，孫策乘其內虛，與周瑜率兩萬兵一舉攻下皖城，俘其妻子及袁術家屬三萬餘人；劉勳回軍彭澤遭孫賁、孫輔截擊，大敗後西走尋陽、置馬亭、西塞，終至流沂降曹操，曹操授其將軍之職，江夏方向自此多了一個敵方支點。荊州方面，200年正月沙羨之戰黃祖軍覆沒，韓唏戰死，士卒溺死者達萬人，孫策繳獲戰船六千艘，黃祖僅以身免，旋為追兵所斬，孫策終於報了父仇，江夏隨即歸入荊州方面而非孫策之手。孫策至此據吳、丹楊、會稽、廬江四郡及江夏一部，兵精將廣，曹操歎「猘兒難與爭鋒」，然同年五月孫策出獵丹徒，為許貢門客所射，傷重而卒，年二十六；弟孫權十八歲嗣位，周瑜留輔，張昭迎之屯吳，孫吳基業由此延續，江東再未易主。
resultEn: The campaign ended in complete victory for Sun Ce. Liu Yao abandoned Dantu and fled west to Yuzhang, hiding in the mountains around Wuhu; most of his men were taken over by Taishi Ci's recruiting, and Liu Yao died soon afterwards. Administrator of Kuaiji Wang Lang was beaten at both Guling and Gaoqian and fled to Shanyin; after the reduction of Kuaiji Sun Ce sent Zhang Zhao to urge him to submit, which he refused, and Sun Ce then took the post of Administrator of Kuaiji himself, treating Yu Fan with the courtesy of a friend; Wang Lang later served Sun Quan. In Wu Commandery Yan Baihu was routed and fled to Yuhang, after which he was never heard of again, and Chen Yu, Xu Zhao and the rest scattered. In Lujiang, when Liu Xun marched west to Haicun in 199, Sun Ce struck at his empty interior, and with Zhou Yu led twenty thousand men to take Wancheng in one assault, capturing his wife and more than thirty thousand members of Yuan Shu's household; Liu Xun turned back to Pengze, was intercepted and routed by Sun Ben and Sun Fu, fled west through Xunyang and the post stations to Xisai, and finally reached Liuyi and surrendered to Cao Cao, who gave him a command, so the Jiangxia area gained a northern anchor. In Jingzhou, at Shacan in the first month of Jian'an five, Huang Zu's army was destroyed, Han Xi was killed, as many as ten thousand soldiers drowned, and Sun Ce took six thousand warships; Huang Zu escaped with his life only to be hunted down and killed, and Sun Ce at last avenged his father, though Jiangxia itself remained in Liu Biao's hands rather than Sun Ce's. Sun Ce now held Wu, Danyang, Kuaiji and Lujiang together with part of Jiangxia, with trained troops and wide territory, and Cao Cao sighed that the wild cub was hard to match in battle. That May, however, Sun Ce was shot while hunting at Dantu by retainers of Xu Gong and died of his wounds at twenty-six; his brother Sun Quan, aged eighteen, succeeded him, Zhou Yu stayed to assist, Zhang Zhao received him at Wu, and the Sun-Wu foundation was carried on, with Jiangdong never again changing hands.
